description: Spreads requests across the replicas of its targets (round-robin, least-connections or random). Links can filter by request type, e.g. to route reads and writes differently.
modeled: Instance selection per policy across all routable replicas of linked targets (follows autoscaling)
Per-link timeout and retries that avoid the failed instance
Technology defaults: upstream timeout (504) and Envoy circuit breakers (503)
Optional rate limit (token bucket); excess rejected as rate_limited

presets.description: Reverse proxy with very low per-request overhead: 2 workers x 1,024 connections, two per proxied request, so 1,024 requests at once; 60 s upstream timeout.
presets.name: Nginx

presets.description: High-performance TCP/HTTP load balancer, least-connections balancing.
presets.name: HAProxy

presets.description: Service proxy (also the data plane of most service meshes): circuit breakers at 1,024 requests per target, 15 s route timeout.
presets.name: Envoy

presets.description: API gateway in front of services, with a global rate limit.
presets.name: Kong API gateway

presets.description: Managed cloud application load balancer (illustrative numbers, not a vendor benchmark).
presets.name: ALB-style load balancer

presets.description: Managed API gateway: higher overhead per request and an account-level rate limit.
presets.name: API-gateway-style (managed)

api_gateway.detail: The gateway waits at most 29 s for the backend by default, then returns 504 (regional and private REST APIs can request more).
api_gateway.title: Integration timeout 29 s

api_gateway.detail: 10,000 requests per second with a 5,000 burst per account and Region by default (token bucket; lower in some newer Regions); excess gets 429. The preset sets these.
api_gateway.title: Account throttle

aws_alb.detail: The load balancer closes a connection idle for 60 s (default), which ends a slow upstream response with 504.
aws_alb.title: Idle timeout 60 s

envoy.detail: Each upstream cluster allows 1,024 concurrent requests by default; beyond that Envoy answers 503 at once instead of queueing.
envoy.title: Circuit breakers (1,024 requests)

envoy.detail: A route waits 15 s for the upstream response by default, then returns 504.
envoy.title: Route timeout 15 s

kong.detail: A Kong service waits 60 s (read_timeout) for the upstream by default.
kong.title: Upstream timeouts 60 s

nginx.detail: nginx gives up on an upstream response after proxy_read_timeout (60 s by default) and returns 504.
nginx.title: Upstream read timeout 60 s

nginx.detail: worker_connections counts every connection, including those to upstream servers, so each proxied request uses two and a worker serves half as many requests (the preset sizes it that way).
nginx.title: Two connections per proxied request
